name: Paper God: Lord Guang Hui Seated under a Shrine
summary: 哈佛艺术博物馆著录：Chinese；early 20th century；Woodblock print; ink, color and gold on paper; with printed inscription reading from right to left: "Chi Feng Hu Guo You Min Guang Hui Wang" ("Imperially Conferred Lord Guang Hui"); gold-foil face attached to the image. Possibly from Beijing.
